items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Her name was Bertie Green. But he pretty much kept control of all the writing, because there wasn’t anything much that anybody could write for that band that would come up to the standards that they were dealing with when they dealt with his music.
